name: ModelHub
description: Self-hosted, open clone of Meshory's 3D print file library: STL/3MF/OBJ/STEP/FBX organization, thumbnails, duplicate detection, tagging, semantic search, smart collections, filament inventory and a print queue. AI tagging/search can run against a local Ollama instance (nothing leaves your network) or an external OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible API using your own key -- switch anytime from the in-app Settings tab. Point "Library Path" at the share where your STL/3MF files already live; nothing is modified on disk, files are only read and hashed. On first open you'll be asked to create an admin login (or set Admin Username/Password below to skip that screen). Also includes print time/filament weight estimates, a browser extension for one-click import from Printables/ MakerWorld, and optional webhook notifications (ntfy/Discord/Slack).

paths.name: Library Path
paths.description: Folder containing your STL/3MF/OBJ/STEP/FBX files. Read-only usage: files are hashed and thumbnailed, never modified.

paths.name: App Config/DB
paths.description: Where the SQLite database, thumbnails, and settings are stored.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the Model Hub web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Unraid's nobody user -- keeps /config editable from the host

variables.name: Scan Interval
variables.description: Seconds between automatic background library scans.

variables.name: Ollama Host
variables.description: Address of your Ollama container/instance for local AI tagging. Only used when AI mode is set to 'local' in the app's Settings tab.

variables.name: Ollama Vision Model
variables.description: Vision-capable Ollama model used for auto-tagging thumbnails.

variables.name: Ollama Embed Model
variables.description: Ollama embedding model used for semantic search.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Creates the admin login automatically on first start. Leave blank to set it up from the WebUI's first-run screen instead.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Paired with Admin Username above. Leave both blank to use the in-app setup screen instead (recommended -- avoids the password sitting in plain text in the container's env).

variables.name: Slicer CLI Path (advanced)
variables.description: Optional: absolute path *inside the container* to a headless slicer CLI binary (e.g. an extracted PrusaSlicer/OrcaSlicer AppImage) for exact print time/filament estimates instead of the built-in volumetric approximation. Bind-mount the binary in via 'Add another Path' first, then point this at it.
